snippet.title: Ashes: Blackwater release trailer
snippet.description:
This is the trailer for an Ashes 2063 sub-mod called Ashes: Blackwater. It's set in an alternate timeline where a certain Scavenger failed to do his job. It's a mainly action and survival focused 6 level episode using reworked old maps from Afterglow and Hard Reset, same for the arsenal with some new mechanics at play.

Now out on ModDB, hope you enjoy playing it :)

Shoutout to our dear loremaster Nii for the trailer.
